attempts.summary: Configured daily log rotation for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 (Alpine Linux) using logrotate, keeping 7 compressed rotations with copytruncate so the writer never has to reopen the file. Installed logrotate via apk, wrote /etc/logrotate.d/inventory, enabled/started crond (which runs /etc/periodic/daily/logrotate) so rotation actually fires daily, and validated behavior with forced rotation cycles. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a pre-restart boot_id baseline, issued a native reboot, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed a changed boot_id/uptime, and re-verified crond, the logrotate config, retained rotated files, and continued writability of app.log post-restart.
